narr: A SW to NE oriented heavy rainfall band crossed Southern Illinois during the late evening hours of the 23rd. A second band formed ahead of the first, and then merged together resulting in a localized higher rainfall total swath of 3-5 inches from Southeast Jackson County through Northwest Williamson County into Southern Franklin County. The highest observed rainfall total was a CoCoRaHS site 2 miles ESE of Bush, IL which received 4.89 inches. Flash flooding was observed in West Frankfort while areas of standing water were observed further west-southwest. Severe weather potential did not end up materializing with this line, likely due to insufficient clearing and poor mid-level lapse rates.
ev: Multiple social media posts and comments reported flash flooding in and around West Frankfort. Radar and rain gauge reports suggest approximately 2 inches of rain in under 90 minutes as two lines of heavy rain merged.
